summary: When no character matches the stopping predicate, the &str implementation returns an empty remainder pointing to the start of the input. Consequently, recognize(multispace0) computes zero consumed bytes for an all-whitespace string and returns an empty recognized slice. The fix uses take_split(input_len()), placing the empty remainder at the end so recognize returns the entire input. The fix adds the selected regression test in tests/issues.rs.

assertion `left == right` failed
  left: Ok(("", ""))
